**OFFICE NOTE**

**To:** All Heads of Departments
**From:** The Registrar
**Subject:** Diwali Holiday Closure

This is to inform all Heads of Departments that the Institute will remain closed on 8 November 2026 in observance of the Diwali holiday.

Consequently, all official work and administrative activities will be suspended on this date. Regular academic classes and institutional operations are scheduled to resume on 9 November 2026.

All HODs are requested to ensure that necessary arrangements are made regarding security and maintenance during the closure period. Staff members are advised to plan their schedules accordingly.

Please disseminate this information to all concerned faculty and non-teaching staff under your jurisdiction.

**Registrar**

**OFFICE ORDER**

**Date:** [Current Date]
**Ref No:** [Reference Number]

**Subject: Appointment as Warden, Teesta Hostel**

The Director is pleased to appoint Dr. K. Rao, Associate Professor (Physics), as the Warden of Teesta Hostel, with effect from 1 November 2026.

Dr. Rao shall discharge the duties and responsibilities associated with the post of Warden with diligence and dedication. In recognition of the additional charge and responsibilities undertaken, an honorarium of Rs 6,000 per month is sanctioned, payable along with the monthly salary.

This order is issued in the interest of the efficient administration of the hostel and the overall welfare of the students residing therein. All concerned staff members are requested to extend their full cooperation to Dr. Rao in the discharge of his new duties.

The Director reserves the right to modify or cancel this order at any time.

**(Signature)**
